mentions.name: claude-governance
mentions.description: A governance tool for Claude Code that lets teams define deterministic policies for AI tool calls, enforced across a fleet and remaining in effect even when individual users run with --dangerously-skip-permissions.
mentions.problem: Ensuring tool-call policies stay enforced even when users bypass Claude Code's permission checks with --dangerously-skip-permissions.
mentions.audience: Teams enforcing tool-call policies across a fleet of Claude Code users
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Claude Code governance tool that allows to define deterministic policies for tool call that can be enforced across a fleet and will be in effect even when individual users run with --dangerously-skip-permissions

evidence.value: I'm working on a Claude Code governance tool that allows to define deterministic policies for tool call that can be enforced across a fleet and will be in effect even when individual users run with --dangerously-skip-permissions
